tagline: Gardens you love, all year round
intro: Friendly, reliable garden design and maintenance across Bristol and the surrounding villages.
about:
Green Leaf started with one van, one mower and a love of tidy borders. Twelve years later we look after more than two hundred gardens across Bristol, from small terraced courtyards to large family lawns.

We turn up when we say we will, leave every garden tidier than we found it, and give honest advice about what will actually thrive in your space.

owner.name: Sam Hart
owner.bio: Sam trained in horticulture at Bath and spent five years on large country estates before starting Green Leaf. He still visits every new garden himself.

values.title: We turn up
values.text: Booked visits happen on the day we agree, every time.

values.title: Honest advice
values.text: We'll tell you what will really grow, not what costs the most.

values.title: Tidy finish
values.text: Every clipping is cleared and taken away before we leave.

services.name: Garden design
services.description: Planting plans and new layouts, designed around how you actually use your garden.

services.name: Lawn care
services.description: Regular mowing, feeding, scarifying and edging to keep your lawn thick and green.

services.name: Hedge trimming
services.description: Neat, healthy hedges of any size, with all clippings taken away.

services.name: Seasonal clear-ups
services.description: Leaves, weeds and overgrowth cleared, ready for the season ahead.

services.name: Planting
services.description: New borders, bulbs and shrubs chosen to suit your soil and light.

services.name: Regular maintenance
services.description: Weekly or fortnightly visits so your garden always looks its best.
